title: Modularized Networks for Few-shot Hateful Meme Detection
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the detection of hateful memes, a task inherently linked to ethical judgments of content. It specifically includes religious group targeting as a category of evaluation (e.g., Table 5 features a case study on 'Hateful (Religion)' related to Islam) and includes a module dedicated to 'hateful meme interpretation' which attempts to explain the moral rationale for a meme's classification.
